purpose: Teach: 南西/貧弱/粘着/一滴/日照/辺境/罪人/首尾

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、南西諸島、つまり南西の島嶼研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, I see you wrote your paper on the Southwest Island region — the island geography of the Southwest.
lines.style: Warm, slightly curious. Gentle confirmation. She's checking in, not testing. Even pace, open posture.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、栄養不足が貧弱な発育を招く医学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the medical research connecting malnutrition to stunted development.
lines.style: Respectful, deliberate. He's correcting gently but firmly. Clear articulation. Not defensive, just accurate.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、粘着剤の高分子化学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on adhesive compounds and polymer chemistry, wasn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. She's genuinely recalling. Warm and encouraging without presumption.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、雨の一滴の科学的解析研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I examined the scientific properties of a single raindrop.
lines.style: Quiet but clear. He's correcting again without apology. Steady, measured delivery. A hint of patience.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、日照時間と農作物の収穫量の関係研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Right — and I believe your research covered the relationship between sunlight and crop yield?
lines.style: Gentle probe. She's offering him space to clarify. Warm inflection on the question. Encouraging without pressure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、辺境地域の社会人類学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, I wrote about social anthropology in frontier regions.
lines.style: Polite but firm. Not harsh — just clear about what he actually did. Even tone, no frustration.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、罪人の更生プログラムの研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your final paper — was it on rehabilitation programs for offenders?
lines.style: Warm, reflective pause. She's genuinely engaged now, wanting to get it right. Open, inviting correction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、研究計画の首尾、つまり首尾一貫性の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: My focus was on research methodology itself — coherence and consistency across a project.
lines.style: Patient closer. He's helped her understand. Soft but certain. A quiet kind of clarity. The relief of being heard.
